note: Reviewed community shorthand ('SSG' -> SpaceStation Gaming) that FACEIT's own name history does not cover. Keys are the folded alias. An alias absent from this file resolves however the fuzzy matcher in resolve.py already would - there is no fallback guess table. Edit by hand or with `python -m owcsmuse alias set`.

cr.note: community shorthand for Crazy Raccoons; not in FACEIT's own name history
